items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: And Didi played with him for a while, I know.

ctx.x: Is that the Jalma Garnier? Yeah. That's who I thought you were talking about. Yeah. That's who I thought you were talking about. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
